URL: https://globalnation.inquirer.net/331711/myanmars-future-middle-east-fighting-hang-over-asean-talks
NOTE: AFP + AP + Reuters (21 Jul). ASEAN foreign ministers meet in Manila Tuesday under shadow of US-Iran war and Myanmar divide. 59th ASEAN FMM held 21 Jul. Attendees incl US Sec State Marco Rubio (landing Manila Tue am), China FM Wang Yi, Russia FM Sergei Lavrov, plus India/Japan/Australia/UK/EU. Rubio open to sideline meetings with Wang and Lavrov (Wang meeting days after Trump accused Beijing of US election meddling). AP: ministers to issue joint statement expressing alarm over Middle East and calling for "complete and immediate cessation of hostilities across all fronts" and "restoration of the safe, unimpeded and continuous transit passage of vessels and aircraft in the Strait of Hormuz" (draft seen by AP). South China Sea code-of-conduct talks with Wang; informal Myanmar consultation 22 Jul. Philippines declared national energy emergency in March, now buying Russian oil. Sources: gmanetwork.com (Reuters), lasvegassun.com (AP).
